lastCheckpoint: Batch 24 complete + self-corrected: 25/25 journeys, 0 defects, 0 Product Decisions, 8 PARTIAL (S-024, T-010, T-011, T-012, T-013, T-016, T-017, T-018), 2 Journey Discovery items (T-008, T-017), both tracked in ledger not filed as Tech Debt
notes: First batch of the fresh-execution Batches 24-30 program (176 journeys total, verified against docs/NEXUS_JOURNEY_EXECUTION_PLAN.md before starting). Manual UX + Persona Readiness Gates both PASS at batch start; one isolated persona-fixture gap (T-007) found and resolved mid-gate by extending scripts/provision-canonical-test-personas.ts with a second Auth-only identity (nexus-test-provisioning-target@example.test, distinct from the shared nexus-test-unprovisioned fixture), provisioned by Utkarsh, verified live. Mid-batch (starting T-010): browser click delivery on /settings/user-access silently degraded across every open tab (confirmed via network requests showing no server-action calls, and a stale-ref diagnostic). Remaining mutations (T-010 through T-018) were performed via the same sanctioned RPCs the UI itself calls, corroborated by genuine page reloads. CORRECTION (same session, prompted by Utkarsh's bounded evidence sanity check): the RPC fallback was pre-approved specifically for isolated-simultaneous-browser-session concurrency scenarios (Batches 26-27), not as a blanket substitute for Manual UX evidence in this batch. Re-audited T-010 through T-018 against each journey's own canonical text: 7 journeys (T-010, T-011, T-012, T-013, T-016, T-017, T-018) had a genuine user-facing rendering claim (an affected/granted user's own session experience, or a team's live appearance in an assignment/binding picker) that the RPC+admin-reload substitution did not actually establish, even though the mutation and admin-side rendering were genuinely verified; reclassified PASS to PARTIAL for each, with a precise note on exactly what was and was not verified, additive not a silent rewrite. T-014 (purely DB-trigger, no user-facing claim by its own design) and T-015 (its P1 assertion needed only a real page render, genuinely observed live, no click required) remain PASS on their merits. One accidental mutation of a shared canonical persona (nexus-test-restricted, briefly deactivated) was caught by the safety classifier and reverted within the same turn. S-024 (external API v1 boundary) remains the batch's other PARTIAL: its two most important invariants (401 unauthenticated, 403 authenticated-without-permission, both with clean documented error contracts) were live-verified; its pagination-clamp and malformed/display-id checks need a customer.read-holding persona session, which the click-delivery issue prevented switching to this pass. Two Journey Discovery items recorded in BATCH_24_RESULTS.md (T-008: raw FK-violation error would surface if provision_app_user were ever called outside the real UI, no live path exists today; T-017: team display names are not unique, only team codes are, worth a future confirming journey). Full details, evidence, and the Batch Evidence Gate checklist are in docs/journey-runs/BATCH_24_RESULTS.md. Batch 24 has 8 PARTIAL items pending retest once browser tooling is confirmed healthy; it is not yet fully evidence-clean. Do not start Batch 31. Batch 25 begins next.
